text: DEFONEOS — MOD Joint Forces Command AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOD × JFC MOD Joint Forces Command AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK MOD Joint Forces Command — joint operations, ISR fusion, cyber operations, JEF, logistics, UKSF. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Structure JFC Structure — Organisation, Command, Doctrine Joint Forces Command: UK's permanent joint headquarters for multi-domain operations. Commander JFC (3-star). Subordinate commands: JFIG, JFC(A), JFC(I). Joint doctrine development. Combined joint operations planning. NATO interoperability. Five Eyes integration. Joint warfare centre. Joint operations headquarters. Command and control hierarchy. Strategic-to-tactical linkage. ISR Joint ISR — Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance Multi-domain ISR fusion: space, air, land, maritime, cyber. Sentinel R1, Shadow R1, Protector RG1. Satellite imagery. Ground-based ISR. Maritime patrol. SIGINT integration (GCHQ). GEOINT (DGI). HUMINT (SIS). OSINT aggregation. ISR tasking and collection management. Intelligence dissemination. All-source analysis. Target nomination. Battlespace awareness. Cyber Cyber Operations — Offensive, Defensive, NCSC UK cyber operations: offensive (GCHQ/NCF), defensive (NCSC), military cyber (77th Brigade). Cyber command and control. Effects-based operations. Network defence. Critical national infrastructure protection. Cyber threat intelligence. Malware analysis. Vulnerability assessment. Incident response. NATO CCDCOE integration. Offensive cyber authorisation (SoS). Cyber resilience. Zero trust architecture. JEF Joint Expeditionary Force — Nordic-Baltic, High North JEF: UK-led multinational force (10 nations). Nordic-Baltic security. High North operations. Rapid reaction capability. Joint exercises (Trident Juncture, Cold Response). Maritime task group. Amphibious capability. Air defence integration. Logistics burden sharing. Intelligence sharing (JEFINT). Strategic communication. Crisis response. Article 5 complement. Northern flank security. Logistics Joint Logistics — Supply Chain, sustainment, DIO Joint logistics: Defence Equipment & Support (DE&S). Defence Infrastructure Organisation (DIO). Joint supply chain. Forward operating base sustainment. Fuel, ammunition, rations. Medical logistics. Equipment maintenance. Pre-positioned stocks. Strategic lift (C-17, A400M, RFA). Host nation support. Contractor logistics. Logistics information systems. Contingency planning. Resilience. Comms Joint Communications — C4ISR, Networks, SATCOM Joint communications: MODNET. Skynet 6 satellite communications. Tactical communications (BOWMAN, Morpheus). C4ISR integration. Network-enabled capability. Information assurance. Cyber resilience. Interoperability with allies. Communications security (COMSEC). Electronic warfare. Spectrum management. Resilient networks. Deployed communications. Cloud migration (MOD Cloud). Medical Joint Medical — Field Hospital, CASEVAC, Mental Health Joint medical: Defence Medical Services (DMS). Role 1-4 medical facilities. CASEVAC/MEDEVAC chains. Field hospitals (202 Field Hospital). Medical intelligence. Trauma care protocols. Mental health support (PTSD, moral injury). Rehabilitation. Veterans' health. Medical logistics. Clinical governance. Training simulation. Mass casualty planning. CBRN medical response. Fires Joint Fires — Integration, Precision, Effects Joint fires: land, maritime, air, cyber integration. Fire support coordination. Precision-guided munitions. Close air support (CAS). Naval gunfire support. Deep fires (Storm Shadow, Brimstone). Counter-battery. Air defence (Sky Sabre, CAMM).
